patterns.root_cause: Requested flavor/AZ has insufficient compute resources

fix.action: Try different AZ or downgrade flavor: hcloud ECS listAvailabilityZones; hcloud ECS listFlavors --az {{output.alt_az}}

patterns.prevention: Pre-check AZ capacity via listAvailabilityZones before create

patterns.root_cause: Image ID invalid or image deleted/unavailable in region

fix.action: List available images: hcloud IMS listImages --os_type Linux --status active

patterns.prevention: Validate image_id via listImages before create-server

patterns.root_cause: Flavor ID invalid or not available in target AZ

fix.action: List valid flavors: hcloud ECS listFlavors --availability_zone {{output.az}}

patterns.prevention: Validate flavor_ref via listFlavors before create-server

patterns.root_cause: VPC or subnet does not exist; must be created via VPC skill first

fix.action: Delegate to huaweicloud-vpc-ops: create VPC + subnet, then retry ECS create

patterns.prevention: Verify vpc_id/subnet_id existence before ECS create

patterns.root_cause: Specified fixed IP already in use within subnet

fix.action: Remove fixed_ip parameter to auto-allocate, or use different subnet

patterns.prevention: Omit fixed_ip for auto-allocation unless user explicitly requires static IP

patterns.root_cause: ECS instance quota exhausted in project/region

fix.action: Request quota increase via console or delegate to huaweicloud-iam-ops for quota management

patterns.prevention: Check quota via showQuota before batch operations

patterns.root_cause: Operation attempted while instance in transitional state (BUILD/RESIZE/REBOOT)

fix.action: Poll ShowServerDetail until status==ACTIVE/SHUTOFF, then retry operation

patterns.prevention: Check instance status before state-dependent operations

patterns.root_cause: Cloud-Cell agent unreachable: network issue or agent not installed/running

fix.action: Check agent status: hcloud ECS showServerCloudCellDetail --server_id {{output.instance_id}}; verify outbound HTTPS (443) in security group

patterns.prevention: Verify Cloud-Cell agent installed and ACTIVE before runCommand

patterns.root_cause: API rate limit exceeded due to rapid consecutive calls

fix.action: Exponential backoff: wait 2^n seconds (max 60s), then retry

patterns.prevention: Add 1s delay between batch API calls; respect Retry-After header

patterns.root_cause: Regional endpoint unreachable: DNS resolution failure or network partition

fix.action: Verify endpoint: hcloud ECS listServers --region {{env.HW_REGION_ID}} --limit 1; check HW_REGION_ID env var

patterns.prevention: Validate region endpoint connectivity at session start
